title: The Major Prophets Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Major Prophets Bible Crossword
description: Solve a major prophets Bible crossword: Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel and Daniel. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Five books and four men: Isaiah, who saw the LORD high and lifted up; Jeremiah, who wept over a city that would not listen; Ezekiel, with his wheel within a wheel and his valley of dry bones; and Daniel in Babylon reading writing on a wall.

The Major Prophets asks you to place each vision with its prophet, which is harder than it sounds once the images start to blur together. The closing verse is Isaiah's line about the grass and the word of our God.

clues.text: He saw the LORD high and lifted up
Prophet of the wheel within a wheel
His book of laments over Jerusalem

verseText: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
